---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an enhancement or new feature
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem It Solves

What problem does this feature solve? What use case does it enable?

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this feature working.

## Alternative Solutions

Have you considered any alternative approaches?

## Use Cases

Who would benefit from this feature? How would they use it?

**Example 1:**
As a [type of user], I want to [action] so that [benefit].

**Example 2:**
...

## Implementation Ideas

If you have thoughts on how this could be implemented, share them here.

## Potential Challenges

Are there any challenges or drawbacks to consider?

## Additional Context

Any other information, mockups, examples from other projects, etc.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues to ensure this hasn't been requested
- [ ] I have considered if this fits the project scope
- [ ] This feature would benefit multiple users (not just me)
- [ ] I am willing to help implement this (if applicable)
